cues: A function is a named block that does one job.
Library functions, like printf, come with C; user defined functions you write yourself.
The prototype announces the function before main.
The call, here inside printf, jumps to it with the arguments forty seven and ninety two.
The definition is the body, and return sends the answer back.
text: A function is a named block that does one job. Library functions, like printf, come with C; user defined functions you write yourself. Three parts. The prototype announces the function before main. The call, here inside printf, jumps to it with the arguments forty seven and ninety two. The definition is the body, and return sends the answer back.
